name: FoMoH
description: Foundation models (FMs) promise to address core limitations of traditional supervised machine learning: (i) reliance on large amounts of labeled data, (ii) task specificity, and (iii) poor transportability. Despite methodological advances in structured electronic health record (EHR) foundation models, no systematic benchmark has validated whether these models meaningfully deliver on these promises. We introduce a benchmark of 14 clinically meaningful prediction tasks spanning patient prognosis and early diagnosis of acute and chronic conditions.
